construction.implementation_origin: New implementation written in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: schema_version, synthetic=true, allowed_hosts, pages (URL -> synthetic text), sources (id,url), tickets (id,subject,body,source_ids), routing (rules,fallback)
shared_schema.output: status, schema_version, synthetic, research envelope, triaged tickets with route, matched_keywords and citations
shared_schema.validation: Single validate function checks all input, route, research and final-output boundaries; strict object fields, unique IDs, allowlisted URLs, reference integrity, digests, accountable owners and priorities
shared_schema.error: One JSON object with status=error and error message on stdout; exit 2

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated input sources retrieve exact text from offline pages fixtures; no network transport is used.
Research produces validated source_id, original URL, full content, SHA-256 digest and explicit synthetic retrieval mode.
Triage validates the research envelope against original fixtures, uses only ticket-linked findings and retains citation IDs, URLs and digests.
Final shared validation verifies ticket identity, decision and complete citation propagation.

behavior.retrieval: Exact URL lookup into explicitly synthetic offline fixtures; missing fixtures fail closed. HTTPS host matching is exact, with no credentials, fragments or nonstandard ports. No redirects occur.
behavior.classification: Case-insensitive substring matching over subject, body and explicitly linked research content; configured keywords are literal, not regex.
behavior.priority: Integer 1 highest through 4 lowest; most urgent matching rule wins, configuration order breaks ties.
behavior.routing: Every matched or fallback route includes category, priority, team and named accountable owner.
behavior.fallback: Unmatched tickets use mandatory configured fallback; empty ticket/source batches are supported.
behavior.determinism: No time, random values, models, live providers or external I/O beyond CLI input/output.

included: Configurable deterministic classification, priority and ownership

test_outcomes.cli_status: passed: one JSON object, status=ok, exit 0
